summary: Bonner County, ID site: a camp in 1924, a 20-foot platform in 1928, a 40-foot pole L-4 tower in 1931, destroyed in 1956. No source describes it today.

facts.design: 40-foot pole tower with L-4 cab (1931), after a 20-foot platform (1928)
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1956; no source describes what, if anything, remains at the site

evidence.supports: about a mile east of Lakeview

evidence.quote: A camp was established here in 1924, with a 20' platform tower added in 1928.
tower was built in 1931, and destroyed in 1956.

evidence.supports: Idaho listing calls it a hike-in site
Lakeview listed as Tower, Gone, Bonner County
Lakeview (Wabaningo) is a separate Bonner County site farther north

corrections.why: Sources describe a 40-foot pole tower from 1931 with an L-4 cab; 6.1 m (20 ft) matches the 1928 20-foot platform. Check the structure height before changing.

sources.title: Idaho lookout list, North Idaho Panhandle

notes_for_editor: The 1924, 1928, 1931 and 1956 dates agree across three pages, but the Forest Lookouts page credits them to one history (Kresek), so they are not independent checks. No source describes the site today, and no access, staffing or visit information was found. Height correction: the record's 6.1 m matches the 1928 platform, not the 40-foot pole of 1931. The record's coordinates match the FFLA list. The separate Wabaningo site is us-id-lakeview-wabaningo.
